note: Display text and formats the app shows. Data definitions live in measures.seed.json; this file only says how to present them.

place.label: Towns & places
place.note: Places are incorporated towns and cities plus census-designated places. They cover only part of the state; blank ground is outside any place.

zcta.label: ZIP codes
zcta.note: ZIP Code Tabulation Areas: Census's area version of USPS ZIP codes, as defined in 2010 (the 2016–20 survey still uses those). Not published for 2006–10.
